body: From vc-20261021T141300 on, each VectorCraft check-in lists commits completed since the last one (main and branches waiting to land), PRs (none: main moves by fast-forward after the gate and the review), each open game's built % and verified count with the change, and overall completeness (rows done over applicable rows). The check-in is now on a 30-minute timer in the session.
summary: Adopted: VectorCraft check-ins report commits, PRs, per-game % changes and overall completeness (from vc-20261021T141300), every 30 min on a timer
